title: Playback, Layering & Mixer Engine

future_start_resolution: freshly verify then-current AIOC and application heads and re-read completed AAI-01, AAI-02 and AAI-03 evidence
define the provider-neutral playback, soundscape-layer and mixer execution contract over AAI-02 AudioAsset, AudioCue, Soundscape and MixPreset identities without rewriting those identities
define the exact rights and capability gates required before any playback operation; AAI-03 negotiation capability cannot override AAI-02 rights evidence
define explicit playable, manual/external, silent, unavailable and degraded behavior so missing or unsupported audio never blocks gameplay
define deterministic layer ordering, gain/mute/mix behavior and receipts without introducing AAI-05 semantic availability resolution
define how local/user-controlled execution differs from provider-controlled or external-reference paths while keeping AAI-06 provider-specific live adapters unauthorized
preserve World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners and prohibit audio runtime state from creating gameplay truth
determine whether AAI-04 needs durable runtime persistence and reserve migration 0022 only if a separately demonstrated schema delta actually requires it
resolve exact AAI-04 deliverables, focused tests/verifier, predecessor regressions and exact-head self-hosted acceptance gate before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize an implementation branch, playback engine code, provider authentication/live catalogs/provider calls, provider-specific adapters, semantic resolver, acquisition/download/copying, scraping, payment, migration 0022, tester distribution, release or deployment.
selection_contract.provider_rule: Playback planning must consume AAI-03 evidence-driven negotiation and AAI-02 rights evidence independently. Unsupported, unknown, provider-contact-required or rights-denied operations remain unavailable; no workaround may bypass provider terms, entitlement or rights boundaries.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Playback, layer and mixer state is presentation/support state only and cannot create or replace canonical World, Event, Scene, Combat, Action, Visibility or other gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01, AAI-02 and AAI-03 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-04 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/intent/cue/soundscape/mix identities and rights evidence remain canonical inputs
AAI-03 adapter capability negotiation remains evidence-driven and cannot override AAI-02 rights
audio intent remains separate from provider identity and provider asset/reference identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown capability remains explicit and fail closed
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
provider adapters may not emulate unsupported operations by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited content copying
AAI-05 semantic resolution and AAI-06 provider-specific live adapters remain unauthorized
migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/live catalog/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read AAI-01/AAI-02/AAI-03 completed evidence plus the AAI program/backlog and this selection contract, resolve the exact provider-neutral playback/layering/mixer, persistence and validation contract, and only then governed-start AAI-04. Until then do not create an implementation branch or reserve migration 0022.
